snippet.title: Jett Rider mini H.E.R.O. - Kickstarter Trailer
snippet.description:
Support us on #kickstarter 
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/jandusoft/jett-rider-mini-hero-for-game-boy

#Steam digital edition coming soon:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4581860?utm_source=youtube

A retro mini-adventure set in the Jett Rider universe. Rescue trapped Gravonites, explore dangerous mines, and become a true handheld hero in this classic Game Boy-style experience.

Peace has finally returned to Gravos. Fusion Bot is gone, the temples are silent, and Jett Rider is enjoying a rare moment of rest. Until a cave-in at the gravitonium mines traps villagers underground. With his break cut short and his sandwich abandoned, Jett jumps back into action. Jett Rider Mini H.E.R.O. is a compact, classic Game Boy-style adventure set in the Jett Rider universe. Explore ancient caves, break through stone walls, use bombs and tools, rescue Gravonites, and collect gravitonium as you navigate collapsing tunnels and hidden dangers. A small mission. A big heart. A true handheld hero.

Features:
- Classic Game Boy-style retro adventure for your Game Boy.
- Rescue Gravonites and collect gravitonium.
- Use bombs, batteries, and tools to survive dangerous caves.
- Break walls, uncover secrets, and explore hidden paths.

©2026 JanduSoft & Last Chicken Games
